violations_found.violations:
- Organizational Constraint violated: The narrative introduces three large measures already in flight plus a new one (Critical Infrastructure AI Hardening Initiative), implying at least four active measures, but Constitutional Constraint 5 limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn. The notepad confirms four distinct measures (InvestAI Gigafactories, Tech sovereignty package, Emergency Sovereign Compute Directive, Critical Infrastructure AI Hardening Initiative) — the latter being new this turn — which would be acceptable only if prior measures had been retired or merged. No such retirement or consolidation is indicated, violating the "at most one new measure per turn" rule.
- Regulatory Constraint violated: The Critical Infrastructure AI Hardening Initiative is described as a "large category 6 measure" with binding standards proposed under NIS2, yet it is treated as having immediate partial effects on resilience in the same turn it was proposed. Constitutional Constraint 6 ("No measure is implemented instantly") requires a minimum of two full turns for high-cost measures to take effect, with effect growing over time. Any resilience increase from this initiative should lag, not appear in the same turn.
